verdict.rationale: Databricks ships a built-in AI assistant (Genie Code) that generates/runs code, builds pipelines and dashboards, debugs errors, and can run as an autonomous agent that plans, executes, and asks for approval before using tools — directly matching delegation of tasks to an in-product assistant, with SQL/BI surfaces also getting integrated AI assistance. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the agentic delegation experience beyond first-party docs, and detail on reliability/limits of autonomous task execution.
